headline: Oil prices fluctuate on supply concerns following Strait of Hormuz incidents
summary: Crude oil prices remain volatile as markets react to reports of mine strikes on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and attacks on Saudi refinery infrastructure.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil transit; any threat to shipping here significantly impacts energy security.
why_moved: Heightened geopolitical tensions and threats to maritime oil transit routes create uncertainty regarding global supply stability.
